question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution: The correct answer is** "surround."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Surround"** means to encircle or encompass, which makes the most sense in the context of the blank. (किसी के चारों ओर होना या किसी को चारों ओर से घेरना) • **Example**: *The house was surrounded by dense woods.* • **"Avoid"** could be a possible answer, but** "surround"** fits better. • The correct answer is Option 4. • **Correct passage**: If you **surround**__ yourself with the good and righteous, they can only ______ (2) ______ you up. If you ______ (3) ______ yourself with the others, they will ______ (4) ______ you down into the doldrums of mediocrity, and they will keep you there, but only as long as you ______ (5) ______ it. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Retreat:** to withdraw or move back. ((सेना का) मोर्चे से पीछे हट जाना (हारकर या फिर से तैयार होने के लिए)) • **Ignore:** to pay no attention to something. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु पर कोई ध्यान न देना, की उपेक्षा करना) • **Avoid:** to keep away from something. (कुछ होने से रोकना; कुछ करने से बचना) 3e:Tccd, The correct answer is **"raise."**
